title: General argument
description: An argument of the topic's, kept in topics/<topic>/arguments/<id>.yaml: any argument-format model record that meets every condition in `requires` (conditions.yaml), and whose other arguments record every verdict in `given` as holding, gets it. A record meets a condition by its own `meets`, by its group's, or by the value of one of its group's parameters. Otherwise an argument as in a model record, with its own id, by and date.

requires.description: Conditions of the topic (conditions.yaml) a record must meet.

given.description: Principles the record's other arguments must record as holding; the argument builds on them.

lean.description: The argument's verdicts proved in Lean: each a theorem that every model meeting the argument's conditions (and holding its `given` principles) has the verdict, stated from the topic's lean.argument templates, or for a group's argument over its lean.binder.

ref.description: The certificate, a declaration whose type is the generated statement.
